summary: Best complementary local inputs are CMS HCRIS hospital cost reports and RWJBH’s published financial-assistance policy materials. HCRIS provides reported provider fiscal periods, utilization, cost and charge data at cost-center and worksheet/line level where reported, and can support resource-cost scenarios when its scope and report status are preserved. RWJUH New Brunswick’s charges page exposes hospital charge files and links to assistance resources; charges must remain distinct from costs and patient payment. No Middlesex County cost estimate or Saint Peter’s assistance-policy document was verified in this bounded search.

sources.title: Cost Reports (HCRIS)
sources.geography: United States; provider-specific reports, including target New Jersey hospitals when present under their Medicare provider IDs
sources.period: Hospital CMS-2552-10 reports available for fiscal years 2010–2026 on the inspected CMS page; CMS-2552-96 covers 1996–2011. Data availability and report status vary by provider and release.
sources.grain: Cost report × provider ID × fiscal period × worksheet/line or coded cost center, depending on source file; annual ZIP files contain report identification, numeric, and alpha-numeric files.
useful_fields: fiscal year beginning and ending dates
report status (e.g. as submitted, settled, reopened)
costs and charges by cost center (total and Medicare)
Medicare settlement and financial statement data
staff and training counts where reported
observed_facts: CMS describes annual cost reports as containing facility characteristics, utilization, cost and charge data by cost center, Medicare settlement data, and financial statement data.
The CMS page lists hospital CMS-2552-10 fiscal years through 2026 in its release status as of October 2026 and says hospital reports are downloadable as fiscal-year ZIP files.
CMS states files include Rpt, Numeric, and Alpha-Numeric data; use report-specific documentation to interpret worksheet codes and values.
sources.retrieval_next_step: For a bounded local slice, retrieve only the hospital fiscal-year ZIPs needed for RWJUH New Brunswick (CCN 310038) and Saint Peter’s (CCN 310070), beginning with the latest common complete year. Filter the report file to those provider IDs; retain all matching report IDs and periods, select or compare amended/settled versus as-submitted/reopened records explicitly, then join numeric/alpha-numeric records using CMS report documentation and preserve original worksheet/line identifiers and source hashes. Treat reported beds as annual reported capacity, not live staffed capacity.
limitations: No target-specific records were acquired or verified in this research pass; the CMS page is discovery, not acquisition.
The HCRIS dataset is what providers reported to CMS through contractors; CMS disclaims responsibility for misinterpretation and says authenticated data is point-in-time.
HCRIS cost allocations and reported beds/FTEs do not by themselves measure marginal cost, live staffing, or locally staffed capacity.
CMS warns the hospital numeric file is too large for Excel; use a database-capable workflow.
A ZIP discovery page was verified, but a direct fiscal-year ZIP URL was not opened, so no file-specific download URL is asserted.

sources.title: 2025 RWJBarnabas Health System-Wide Financial Assistance Policy & Billing/Collection Policy
sources.geography: System policy search result names Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, Inc. – New Brunswick; coverage for Saint Peter’s was not established.
sources.period: Search result identifies a 2025 policy; current effectiveness/version needs verification.
sources.grain: Policy version × covered hospital/entity × eligibility, discount, billing and collection terms.
observed_facts: RWJBH’s official search result names RWJUH New Brunswick among entities in a 2025 system-wide policy.
The official PDF URL returned a fetch error during inspection, so document contents and operative status could not be verified.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Use RWJBH’s financial-resources page to locate the currently linked Financial Assistance Policy and application; download the policy and record its title, effective/revision date, covered entities, and source URL. Separately locate Saint Peter’s official financial-assistance policy and confirm whether the system policy covers that entity before modeling eligibility or discounts.
limitations: The linked PDF could not be inspected and its direct URL may be stale; access is unverified.
Do not assume the RWJBH system policy applies to Saint Peter’s Hospital.
Policy terms describe assistance rules, not realized bad debt, charity care amounts, or actual patient-level outcomes.

sources.title: Charges – RWJ University Hospital New Brunswick
sources.publisher: RWJ University Hospital New Brunswick / RWJBarnabas Health
sources.geography: RWJ University Hospital New Brunswick, New Brunswick, Middlesex County, New Jersey
sources.period: Page states files are updated annually; the specific file version/date was not established in this inspection.
sources.grain: Hospital standard charge item/service and DRG charge; linked machine-readable pricing file may include payer-specific negotiated charges and cash prices, subject to file schema.
useful_fields: machine-readable pricing fields as defined by the linked file
observed_facts: The hospital says its standard-charge listing includes items and services and average charges for DRGs, and that it is updated annually.
The page links a chargemaster download, DRG charge listing, machine-readable file, and shoppable-services file.
The page cautions that chargemaster values are not a reliable measure of what a patient pays; it describes discounted cash price as an estimated gross charge.
sources.retrieval_next_step: Follow the hospital page’s current chargemaster and machine-readable-file links; record the retrieval date, file version, hospital scope, field definitions, and hash. Use charges only for billed-price or payer-price scenarios, never as resource cost or realized payment.
limitations: Actual downloadable file URLs and schemas were not opened, so they are not provided as verified direct download URLs.
Charge values are not costs or patient liability; patient-specific coverage and circumstances affect what is paid.
The page establishes RWJUH New Brunswick scope only, not Saint Peter’s or Middlesex County totals.

missing_inputs: No locally acquired HCRIS report slice for either target hospital, with fiscal year, amendment/status, and worksheet/line references retained.
No verified current Saint Peter’s financial-assistance policy or proof that the RWJBH system policy covers it.
No verified cost-accounting dataset for Middlesex County or hospital-specific marginal/resource costs; local HCRIS reports are accounting aggregates and not causal cost estimates.
No retrieved current RWJUH charge or machine-readable pricing file with its exact version, schema, and download URL.
simulation_use: Candidate research only; independently verify the current CMS fiscal-year downloads, match CCNs and report statuses, and inspect policy coverage before incorporating values. HCRIS can inform annual facility/cost-center resource scenarios when worksheet lines, fiscal periods, amendments, and report status are preserved. A charge file can inform a separate billed-price scenario. Model financial assistance from verified policy rules as eligibility and discount logic, not as realized charity care or payment. Keep reported capacity separate from live staffed beds and avoid inventing local cost rates where the reports do not identify them.
limitations: Searches were limited to two and four primary-source page opens; no local files, acquisition, or calculations were performed.
CMS HCRIS page was inspected; the assistance PDF URL returned a fetch error, and the CMS data catalog open returned no inspectable content.
All source listings are discovery candidates, not acquired datasets or independently verified inputs.
